Motion control joins logic signals with power electronics and mechanical loads.

| System | Command | Typical feedback |
|:--|:--|:--|
| DC motor | direction and PWM | speed or position encoder |
| H-bridge | direction and PWM | current, speed, or position |
| hobby servo | command pulse | internal position feedback |
| stepper driver | step and direction | often open loop; optional encoder |

Check supply voltage, running and stall current, driver rating, switching loss, thermal path, flyback or recirculation, direction logic, and stop behaviour.

GPIO pins do not drive motors directly. Use a transistor, MOSFET, H-bridge, or driver board rated for the load.

## Investigation

Predict speed or position response, collect sample data, graph command and measured output, identify response features, make one design change, and show whether performance improved.
